_about: One source for the game's name, one-line description, credits, support text and links. The game reads it (Credits screen) and so does tools/web_postexport.py (the play page). Keep the support text and the Amazon link wherever the credits appear.
name: Gassy Donkey
tagline: A farting donkey runs, jumps, headbutts and farts through the Amazon and the desert.

credits.role: Idea, design and the 2014 and 2016 originals
2016 art: the donkey, the vessel, the World 1 platforms, the logo

credits.who: most likely NASA (source not recorded in 2016)

credits.role: Godot port and finishing the game (code, placeholder art, sound effects, song loops)

credits.who: Comic Relief and Liberation Sans (SIL Open Font License)

history: BIDU, the farting donkey, started as a sketch in 2014. In 2016 it became Gassy Donkey, a Unity 5.3.5 project that got as far as its main menu. In 2026 it was ported to Godot and finished.
support: Brought to you by Deovandski, author of the #HusbandOutWorld series and CEO/Founder of Wizard Deo Solutions. Have fun! If you want to support me, buy the eBooks on Amazon.
